name: Aubrey’s Aesthetics
description: I am the owner of Aubrey's Aesthetics, which I opened in 2024 after completing my advanced training in esthetics. After graduating from Gulf Shores High School in 2021 I moved to Utah where graduated from esthetician school in 2022. I became a Master Esthetician with the highest level of training and education. I specialize in facials, waxing, beauty treatments and much more! I improve peoples skin with customized treatments, my advanced esthetics knowledge, and passion for skincare. You will leave feeling relaxed, rejuvenated and see immediate results. Most importantly to feel beautiful inside and out. I'm so blessed to be able to do what I love! ALL GLORY TO GOD! Skincare, Beauty & Health are my favorite things to learn about. I continue my education each and everyday. I love going to esthetician conventions, helping people feel confident, and achieving the BEST results. I know with my drive & passion for esthetics; I will change the game for esthetics in Alabama. We are the most affordable spa on the Gulf Coast. As a solo Master Esthetician in Orange Beach, Alabama I improve every kind of skin with customized treatments, my advanced esthetics education, and passion for skincare. You will leave feeling relaxed, see results, & be rejuvenated.
